props.animation_script:
// =============================================================================

// Ignis Finis (bespoke, shared Dryad + Marigold). Parametric via a CFG object.

// Dim the scene -> fire particles gather at the target -> orange shimmer pulse

// -> CastFire01 webm plays large at the target with a screenshake. doneHook

// fires when the webm's flame peaks; then the dim fades out.

// =============================================================================

(async () => {

const CFG = {"fireColor":16742944,"dimAlpha":0.55,"dimMs":400,"undimMs":500,"gatherRadius":0.22,"gatherCount":26,"gatherSize":0.03,"gatherMs":620,"gatherStagger":6,"shimmerAlpha":0.22,"shimmerMs":700,"castSize":1.55,"castMaxMs":2400,"doneAtMs":500,"shakeMs":620,"shakePx":10,"fadeMs":340,"totalTimeoutMs":14000,"name":"Ignis Finis","sfxCast":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Scorch.ogg","sfxCastVol":0.6,"sfxExplosion":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Amalthea_Explosion.ogg","sfxExplosionVol":0.6,"key":"marigold_ignisfinis"};

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][IgnisFinis][" + CFG.name + "]";

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.gen.ignisfinis." + CFG.key;

const CAST_URL = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Cast/CastFire01_01_Regular_Orange_600x600.webm";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = "oni.anim." + ANIM_KEY + "." + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function onceHook(name, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(name, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(name, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(name, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(name, data) { try { Hooks.callAll(name, data); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targetTokens = ctx.targetTokens || [];

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const A = ctx.params.assets;

const stage = canvas.stage;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

const WT = stage.worldTransform.clone();

const ZOOM = Math.abs(stage.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const S2W = (fx, fy) => WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(fx * W, fy * H));

const wLen = (px) => px / ZOOM;

const hPx = (frac) => wLen(frac * H);

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(ms) || 0));

const spawned = [];

function destroyObj(o) { try { if (o && !o._destroyed) { if (o.parent) o.parent.removeChild(o); o.destroy({ children: true }); } } catch (_) {} }

function cleanupAll() { for (const o of spawned.splice(0)) destroyObj(o); }

let doneFired = false;

function fireDone(res) { if (doneFired) return; doneFired = true; try { Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.doneHook, res || { ok: true }); } catch (_) {} }

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

const easeInCubic = (t) => t * t * t;

function tween(fn, dur, ease) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const t0 = performance.now();

const step = () => { const raw = dur>0?Math.min(1,(performance.now()-t0)/dur):1; try{fn(ease?ease(raw):raw,raw);}catch(_){} if(raw>=1){ticker.remove(step);resolve();} };

ticker.add(step);

});

}

function dotTexture(hex) {

const s = 64; const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = cv.height = s;

const g = cv.getContext("2d");

const col = "#" + (hex >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(6, "0").slice(-6);

const grd = g.createRadialGradient(s/2, s/2, 0, s/2, s/2, s/2);

grd.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff"); grd.addColorStop(0.4, col); grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");

g.fillStyle = grd; g.beginPath(); g.arc(s/2, s/2, s/2, 0, Math.PI*2); g.fill();

return PIXI.Texture.from(cv);

}

function fullRect(color, alpha, z, blend) {

const a = S2W(-0.1,-0.1), b = S2W(1.1,1.1);

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.beginFill(color, 1).drawRect(a.x, a.y, b.x-a.x, b.y-a.y).endFill();

g.alpha = alpha; g.zIndex = z; if (blend) g.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

return g;

}

function screenShake(ms, px) {

try {

const view = canvas.app.view;

if (!document.getElementById("oni-shake-kf")) {

const st = document.createElement("style"); st.id = "oni-shake-kf";

st.textContent = "@keyframes oniShake{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}15%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px," + px + "px)}30%{transform:translate(" + px + "px,-" + px + "px)}45%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px,-" + px + "px)}60%{transform:translate(" + px + "px," + px + "px)}75%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px,0)}} .oni-shaking{animation:oniShake 0.42s linear}";

document.head.appendChild(st);

}

view.classList.remove("oni-shaking"); void view.offsetWidth; view.classList.add("oni-shaking");

setTimeout(() => { try { view.classList.remove("oni-shaking"); } catch(_){} }, ms);

} catch (_) {}

}

async function loadVideo(url) {

const vid = document.createElement("video");

try { vid.crossOrigin = "anonymous"; } catch (_) {}

vid.src = url; vid.muted = true; vid.loop = false; vid.playsInline = true; vid.preload = "auto";

await new Promise((res) => { let done=false; const go=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;res();}; vid.addEventListener("loadeddata",go,{once:true}); vid.addEventListener("error",go,{once:true}); setTimeout(go,1500); });

return vid;

}

function playSfx(url, vol) {

if (!url) return;

try { const a = new Audio(url); a.volume = (vol == null ? 0.6 : vol); a.play().catch(() => {}); } catch (_) {}

}

try {

const who = targetTokens[0] || caster;

const pt = who ? { x: who.center.x, y: who.center.y } : { x: S2W(0.6,0.5).x, y: S2W(0.6,0.5).y };

const dotTex = dotTexture(cfg.fireColor);

// 1) dim the scene

playSfx(cfg.sfxCast, cfg.sfxCastVol); // initial cast

const dim = fullRect(0x000000, 0, 7000, false);

stage.addChild(dim); spawned.push(dim);

await tween((p) => { dim.alpha = cfg.dimAlpha * p; }, cfg.dimMs, easeOutCubic);

// 2) fire particles gather at the target

const gatherR = hPx(cfg.gatherRadius);

const gathers = [];

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.gatherCount; i++) {

const ang = Math.random()*Math.PI*2, r = gatherR*(0.7+Math.random()*0.5);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(dotTex);

sp.anchor.set(0.5); sp.zIndex = 7200; sp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; sp.tint = cfg.fireColor;

const sz = hPx(cfg.gatherSize)*(0.6+Math.random()*0.8); sp.width = sp.height = sz;

sp.x = pt.x + Math.cos(ang)*r; sp.y = pt.y + Math.sin(ang)*r; sp.alpha = 0;

stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp); gathers.push({ sp, ox: sp.x, oy: sp.y });

}

const gatherAnim = Promise.all(gathers.map(({sp,ox,oy},i) => (async () => {

await waitMs(i * (cfg.gatherStagger||6));

await tween((p) => { sp.x = ox + (pt.x-ox)*p; sp.y = oy + (pt.y-oy)*p; sp.alpha = Math.sin(p*Math.PI); sp.scale.set(1 - 0.3*p); }, cfg.gatherMs, easeInCubic);

destroyObj(sp);

})()));

// 3) orange shimmer pulse over the scene

const shim = fullRect(cfg.fireColor, 0, 7100, true);

stage.addChild(shim); spawned.push(shim);

tween((p) => { shim.alpha = Math.sin(p*Math.PI) * cfg.shimmerAlpha; }, cfg.shimmerMs, null).then(() => destroyObj(shim));

await Promise.race([gatherAnim, waitMs(cfg.gatherMs + 120)]);

// 4) CastFire webm large at the target + screenshake

const vid = await loadVideo(A.cast);

const tex = PIXI.Texture.from(vid);

const nativeW = tex.width || tex.orig?.width || 600;

const spr = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

spr.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5); spr.x = pt.x; spr.y = pt.y; spr.zIndex = 8000;

spr.scale.set(hPx(cfg.castSize) / nativeW);

spr.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

stage.addChild(spr); spawned.push(spr);

try { vid.currentTime = 0; await vid.play(); } catch (_) {}

screenShake(cfg.shakeMs, cfg.shakePx);

playSfx(cfg.sfxExplosion, cfg.sfxExplosionVol); // ending explosion

await waitMs(cfg.doneAtMs);

fireDone({ ok: true });

await new Promise((res) => { let done=false; const go=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;res();}; vid.addEventListener("ended",go,{once:true}); setTimeout(go, cfg.castMaxMs); });

await tween((p) => { spr.alpha = 1 - p; }, cfg.fadeMs, easeOutCubic);

destroyObj(spr);

try { vid.pause(); vid.removeAttribute("src"); vid.load(); } catch (_) {}

// 5) undim

await tween((p) => { dim.alpha = cfg.dimAlpha * (1 - p); }, cfg.undimMs, easeOutCubic);

cleanupAll();

} catch (err) {

console.error("[ONI][Pseudo][IgnisFinis]", err);

fireDone({ ok: false, error: String(err && err.message || err) });

} finally {

cleanupAll();

}

`;

try {

emitLocal("oni:animationStart", { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 14000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG, assets: { cast: CAST_URL } },

meta: { source: CFG.name },

});

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, "pseudo non-OK / timeout", result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "orchestration crashed", err);

} finally {

emitLocal("oni:animationEnd", { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();

// =============================================================================

// T1 - DOM melee lunge (pure PIXI, no webm). Parametric via a CFG object.

// Caster lunges toward the target, N glowing slash streaks rake across it, the

// target sprite shakes, embers fly. doneHook fires at the impact apex.

// =============================================================================

(async () => {

const CFG = {"lungeFrac":0.42,"lungeMs":150,"returnMs":180,"slashLen":0.24,"slashWidth":6,"slashCount":1,"slashGap":0.03,"slashStagger":55,"slashTilt":0.35,"particleCount":12,"particleSize":0.02,"particleSpread":0.12,"particleMs":500,"shakePx":0.012,"shakeMs":260,"endPadMs":120,"totalTimeoutMs":8000,"name":"Thorn Whip","key":"marigold_thornwhip","slashColor":11992954,"particleColor":6736947};

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Melee][" + CFG.name + "]";

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.gen.melee." + CFG.key;

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = "oni.anim." + ANIM_KEY + "." + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function onceHook(name, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(name, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(name, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(name, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(name, data) { try { Hooks.callAll(name, data); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targetTokens = ctx.targetTokens || [];

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const stage = canvas.stage;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

const WT = stage.worldTransform.clone();

const ZOOM = Math.abs(stage.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const wLen = (px) => px / ZOOM;

const hPx = (frac) => wLen(frac * H);

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(ms) || 0));

const spawned = [];

function destroyObj(o) { try { if (o && !o._destroyed) { if (o.parent) o.parent.removeChild(o); o.destroy({ children: true }); } } catch (_) {} }

function cleanupAll() { for (const o of spawned.splice(0)) destroyObj(o); }

let doneFired = false;

function fireDone(res) { if (doneFired) return; doneFired = true; try { Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.doneHook, res || { ok: true }); } catch (_) {} }

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

const easeInCubic = (t) => t * t * t;

const easeInOutCubic = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;

function tween(fn, dur, ease) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const t0 = performance.now();

const step = () => {

const raw = dur > 0 ? Math.min(1, (performance.now() - t0) / dur) : 1;

try { fn(ease ? ease(raw) : raw, raw); } catch (_) {}

if (raw >= 1) { ticker.remove(step); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(step);

});

}

// token sprite clone + hide/restore (works for any token)

function meshOf(tok) { return tok ? tok.mesh : null; }

function makeSprite(tok, faceSign) {

const m = meshOf(tok);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(m?.texture ?? PIXI.Texture.WHITE);

sp.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5);

sp.width = Math.abs(m?.width ?? (tok?.w ?? 100));

sp.height = Math.abs(m?.height ?? (tok?.h ?? 100));

sp.angle = m?.angle ?? 0;

const sx = Math.sign(m?.scale?.x ?? 1) || 1;

const sy = Math.sign(m?.scale?.y ?? 1) || 1;

sp.scale.x = Math.abs(sp.scale.x) * sx * (faceSign || 1);

sp.scale.y = Math.abs(sp.scale.y) * sy;

return sp;

}

function makeHider(tok) {

const m = meshOf(tok);

let on = false, tR = true, mR = true;

const guard = () => { if (!tok) return; tok.renderable = false; if (m) m.renderable = false; };

return {

start() { if (!tok || on) return; on = true; tR = tok.renderable ?? true; mR = m?.renderable ?? true; ticker.add(guard); },

restore() {

if (!tok || !on) return; ticker.remove(guard);

tok.renderable = tR; if (m) m.renderable = mR;

try { tok.renderFlags.set({ refreshVisibility: true, refreshMesh: true, refreshState: true }); } catch (_) {}

on = false;

},

};

}

// a radial-gradient soft dot texture for embers

function dotTexture(hex) {

const s = 64; const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = cv.height = s;

const g = cv.getContext("2d");

const col = "#" + (hex >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(6, "0").slice(-6);

const grd = g.createRadialGradient(s/2, s/2, 0, s/2, s/2, s/2);

grd.addColorStop(0, col); grd.addColorStop(0.4, col); grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");

g.fillStyle = grd; g.beginPath(); g.arc(s/2, s/2, s/2, 0, Math.PI*2); g.fill();

return PIXI.Texture.from(cv);

}

try {

const home = caster ? { x: caster.center.x, y: caster.center.y } : { x: WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(0.3*W,0.5*H)).x, y: WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(0.3*W,0.5*H)).y };

const tgtTok = targetTokens[0] || null;

const tgt = tgtTok ? { x: tgtTok.center.x, y: tgtTok.center.y } : { x: WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(0.7*W,0.5*H)).x, y: WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(0.7*W,0.5*H)).y };

const dx = tgt.x - home.x, dy = tgt.y - home.y;

const faceSign = (tgt.x < home.x) ? -1 : 1;

const apex = { x: home.x + dx * cfg.lungeFrac, y: home.y + dy * cfg.lungeFrac };

// 1) lunge caster toward target

const casterHide = makeHider(caster);

casterHide.start();

const clone = makeSprite(caster, faceSign);

clone.x = home.x; clone.y = home.y; clone.zIndex = 9000;

stage.addChild(clone); spawned.push(clone);

await tween((p) => { clone.x = home.x + (apex.x-home.x)*p; clone.y = home.y + (apex.y-home.y)*p; }, cfg.lungeMs, easeInCubic);

// 2) IMPACT: slashes + shake + embers (fire done here)

const dotTex = dotTexture(cfg.particleColor);

const slashLen = hPx(cfg.slashLen);

const slashHalf = slashLen / 2;

const baseAng = Math.atan2(dy, dx) - Math.PI/2 + (cfg.slashTilt || 0);

// shake target via clone

const tgtHide = makeHider(tgtTok);

let tgtClone = null;

if (tgtTok) {

tgtHide.start();

tgtClone = makeSprite(tgtTok, 1);

tgtClone.x = tgt.x; tgtClone.y = tgt.y; tgtClone.zIndex = 8500;

stage.addChild(tgtClone); spawned.push(tgtClone);

}

const shakeAmp = hPx(cfg.shakePx);

const shake = tween((p) => {

if (!tgtClone) return;

const d = (1 - p) * shakeAmp;

tgtClone.x = tgt.x + (Math.random()*2-1) * d;

tgtClone.y = tgt.y + (Math.random()*2-1) * d;

}, cfg.shakeMs, null).then(() => { if (tgtClone) { tgtClone.x = tgt.x; tgtClone.y = tgt.y; } });

fireDone({ ok: true });

// slash streaks

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.slashCount; i++) {

const off = (i - (cfg.slashCount-1)/2) * hPx(cfg.slashGap);

const perpX = Math.cos(baseAng + Math.PI/2), perpY = Math.sin(baseAng + Math.PI/2);

const cx = tgt.x + perpX * off, cy = tgt.y + perpY * off;

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.zIndex = 9100; g.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

const ax = Math.cos(baseAng), ay = Math.sin(baseAng);

g.lineStyle(wLen(cfg.slashWidth), cfg.slashColor, 1);

g.moveTo(cx - ax*slashHalf, cy - ay*slashHalf);

g.lineTo(cx + ax*slashHalf, cy + ay*slashHalf);

g.x = 0; g.y = 0; g.alpha = 0;

stage.addChild(g); spawned.push(g);

(async () => {

await waitMs(i * cfg.slashStagger);

await tween((p) => { g.alpha = p; }, 70, easeOutCubic);

await tween((p) => { g.alpha = 1 - p; }, 220, easeInCubic);

destroyObj(g);

})();

}

// embers

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.particleCount; i++) {

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(dotTex);

sp.anchor.set(0.5); sp.zIndex = 9050; sp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

const sz = hPx(cfg.particleSize) * (0.6 + Math.random()*0.8);

sp.width = sp.height = sz;

sp.x = tgt.x; sp.y = tgt.y; sp.tint = cfg.particleColor;

stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp);

const ang = Math.random()*Math.PI*2, spd = hPx(cfg.particleSpread) * (0.4 + Math.random());

const vx = Math.cos(ang)*spd, vy = Math.sin(ang)*spd - hPx(0.02);

(async () => {

await tween((p) => { sp.x = tgt.x + vx*p; sp.y = tgt.y + vy*p + hPx(0.05)*p*p; sp.alpha = 1 - p; sp.scale.set((1-0.5*p)); }, cfg.particleMs, easeOutCubic);

destroyObj(sp);

})();

}

await shake;

if (tgtTok) tgtHide.restore();

// 3) return caster home

clone.scale.x = Math.abs(clone.scale.x) * (Math.sign(clone.scale.x) || 1) * ((home.x < apex.x) ? -1 : 1);

await tween((p) => { clone.x = apex.x + (home.x-apex.x)*p; clone.y = apex.y + (home.y-apex.y)*p; }, cfg.returnMs, easeInOutCubic);

destroyObj(clone);

casterHide.restore();

await waitMs(cfg.endPadMs);

cleanupAll();

} catch (err) {

console.error("[ONI][Pseudo][Melee]", err);

fireDone({ ok: false, error: String(err && err.message || err) });

} finally {

cleanupAll();

}

`;

try {

emitLocal("oni:animationStart", { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 8000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

meta: { source: CFG.name },

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "orchestration crashed", err);

} finally {

emitLocal("oni:animationEnd", { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();

props.animation_script:
// =============================================================================

// Marigold - Blazing Tether (links two targets, burn transfer). Bespoke, PIXI.

// Dim the scene -> a fiery shimmering tether snaps between the two targets

// (falls back to caster->target if only one) -> a ball of fire slides along it

// showing the burn transfer -> tether frays out, undim + cleanup. doneHook

// fires when the ball reaches the far end.

// =============================================================================

(async () => {

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.marigold.blazingtether";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][BlazingTether]";

const CFG = {

dimAlpha: 0.5, dimMs: 300, undimMs: 420,

lineColor: 0xFF7A20, coreColor: 0xFFE0A0,

formMs: 320, holdMs: 260,

wobbleAmp: 0.02, wobbleFreq: 2.4, wobbleSpeed: 0.006, segments: 24, lineWidth: 5,

emberEveryMs: 40, emberSize: 0.016, emberMs: 520,

ballSize: 0.05, ballMs: 620, ballTrailMs: 220,

frayMs: 320, endPadMs: 150, totalTimeoutMs: 10000,

sfx: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/FireSword.mp3", sfxVol: 0.6,

};

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = "oni.anim." + ANIM_KEY + "." + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function onceHook(name, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(name, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(name, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(name, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(name, data) { try { Hooks.callAll(name, data); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targetTokens = ctx.targetTokens || [];

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const stage = canvas.stage;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

const WT = stage.worldTransform.clone();

const ZOOM = Math.abs(stage.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const S2W = (fx, fy) => WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(fx * W, fy * H));

const wLen = (px) => px / ZOOM;

const hPx = (frac) => wLen(frac * H);

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(ms) || 0));

const spawned = [];

function destroyObj(o) { try { if (o && !o._destroyed) { if (o.parent) o.parent.removeChild(o); o.destroy({ children: true }); } } catch (_) {} }

function cleanupAll() { for (const o of spawned.splice(0)) destroyObj(o); }

let doneFired = false;

function fireDone(res) { if (doneFired) return; doneFired = true; try { Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.doneHook, res || { ok: true }); } catch (_) {} }

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1-t,3);

const easeInQuad = (t) => t*t;

function tween(fn, dur, ease) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const t0 = performance.now();

const step = () => { const raw = dur>0?Math.min(1,(performance.now()-t0)/dur):1; try{fn(ease?ease(raw):raw,raw);}catch(_){} if(raw>=1){ticker.remove(step);resolve();} };

ticker.add(step);

});

}

function dotTexture(hex) {

const s = 64; const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = cv.height = s;

const g = cv.getContext("2d");

const col = "#" + (hex >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(6, "0").slice(-6);

const grd = g.createRadialGradient(s/2, s/2, 0, s/2, s/2, s/2);

grd.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff"); grd.addColorStop(0.4, col); grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");

g.fillStyle = grd; g.beginPath(); g.arc(s/2, s/2, s/2, 0, Math.PI*2); g.fill();

return PIXI.Texture.from(cv);

}

function fullRect(color, alpha, z) {

const a = S2W(-0.1,-0.1), b = S2W(1.1,1.1);

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.beginFill(color, 1).drawRect(a.x, a.y, b.x-a.x, b.y-a.y).endFill();

g.alpha = alpha; g.zIndex = z;

return g;

}

function playSfx(url, vol) {

if (!url) return;

try { const a = new Audio(url); a.volume = (vol == null ? 0.6 : vol); a.play().catch(() => {}); } catch (_) {}

}

try {

playSfx(cfg.sfx, cfg.sfxVol);

// two endpoints: targets[0] & targets[1], else caster -> targets[0]

let A, B;

if (targetTokens.length >= 2) { A = targetTokens[0].center; B = targetTokens[1].center; }

else if (targetTokens.length === 1 && caster) { A = caster.center; B = targetTokens[0].center; }

else if (targetTokens.length === 1) { A = { x: S2W(0.4,0.5).x, y: S2W(0.4,0.5).y }; B = targetTokens[0].center; }

else { A = { x: S2W(0.4,0.45).x, y: S2W(0.4,0.45).y }; B = { x: S2W(0.65,0.6).x, y: S2W(0.65,0.6).y }; }

A = { x: A.x, y: A.y }; B = { x: B.x, y: B.y };

const dx = B.x-A.x, dy = B.y-A.y; const L = Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;

const ux = dx/L, uy = dy/L; const px = -uy, py = ux; // perpendicular

const amp = hPx(cfg.wobbleAmp);

const fireTex = dotTexture(cfg.lineColor);

const coreTex = dotTexture(cfg.coreColor);

// 1) dim

const dim = fullRect(0x000000, 0, 7000);

stage.addChild(dim); spawned.push(dim);

await tween((p)=>{ dim.alpha = cfg.dimAlpha*p; }, cfg.dimMs, easeOutCubic);

// 2) shimmering tether (redrawn each frame)

const line = new PIXI.Graphics(); line.zIndex = 8000; line.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

stage.addChild(line); spawned.push(line);

let grow = 0, phase = 0, alive = true;

function ptAt(t) {

const wob = Math.sin(t*Math.PI*cfg.wobbleFreq + phase) * amp * Math.sin(t*Math.PI);

return { x: A.x + dx*t + px*wob, y: A.y + dy*t + py*wob };

}

const draw = () => {

if (!alive) return;

phase += cfg.wobbleSpeed * (ticker.deltaMS || 16);

line.clear();

const end = grow;

const glowW = wLen(cfg.lineWidth);

// outer glow

line.lineStyle(glowW*2.4, cfg.lineColor, 0.28);

let started=false;

for (let i = 0; i <= cfg.segments; i++) {

const t = (i/cfg.segments)*end; const q = ptAt(t);

if (!started){ line.moveTo(q.x,q.y); started=true; } else line.lineTo(q.x,q.y);

}

// bright core

line.lineStyle(glowW, cfg.coreColor, 0.95);

started=false;

for (let i = 0; i <= cfg.segments; i++) {

const t = (i/cfg.segments)*end; const q = ptAt(t);

if (!started){ line.moveTo(q.x,q.y); started=true; } else line.lineTo(q.x,q.y);

}

};

ticker.add(draw);

await tween((p)=>{ grow = p; }, cfg.formMs, easeOutCubic);

// embers drifting off the tether

let lastEmber = 0, emitEmbers = true;

const emberTick = () => {

if (!emitEmbers) return;

const now = performance.now();

if (now - lastEmber < cfg.emberEveryMs) return;

lastEmber = now;

const t = Math.random(); const q = ptAt(t);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(fireTex);

sp.anchor.set(0.5); sp.zIndex = 8010; sp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; sp.tint = cfg.lineColor;

const sz = hPx(cfg.emberSize)*(0.6+Math.random()); sp.width=sp.height=sz;

sp.x = q.x; sp.y = q.y; stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp);

const vy = -hPx(0.04)*(0.5+Math.random());

tween((p)=>{ sp.y = q.y + vy*p; sp.alpha = 1-p; sp.scale.set(1-0.4*p); }, cfg.emberMs, easeOutCubic).then(()=>destroyObj(sp));

};

ticker.add(emberTick);

// 3) fireball transfers along the tether A -> B

const ball = new PIXI.Sprite(coreTex);

ball.anchor.set(0.5); ball.zIndex = 8050; ball.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; ball.tint = cfg.coreColor;

const bs = hPx(cfg.ballSize); ball.width = ball.height = bs;

stage.addChild(ball); spawned.push(ball);

let lastTrail = 0;

await tween((p)=>{

const q = ptAt(p); ball.x = q.x; ball.y = q.y;

const now = performance.now();

if (now-lastTrail > 16) {

lastTrail = now;

const tr = new PIXI.Sprite(fireTex);

tr.anchor.set(0.5); tr.zIndex = 8040; tr.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; tr.tint = cfg.lineColor;

tr.width = tr.height = bs*0.9; tr.x = q.x; tr.y = q.y;

stage.addChild(tr); spawned.push(tr);

tween((r)=>{ tr.alpha=1-r; tr.scale.set(1-0.5*r); }, cfg.ballTrailMs, easeOutCubic).then(()=>destroyObj(tr));

}

}, cfg.ballMs, easeInQuad);

destroyObj(ball);

fireDone({ ok: true });

await waitMs(cfg.holdMs);

// 4) fray out

emitEmbers = false;

await tween((p)=>{ line.alpha = 1-p; }, cfg.frayMs, easeOutCubic);

alive = false; ticker.remove(draw); ticker.remove(emberTick);

destroyObj(line);

// 5) undim + cleanup

await tween((p)=>{ dim.alpha = cfg.dimAlpha*(1-p); }, cfg.undimMs, easeOutCubic);

await waitMs(cfg.endPadMs);

cleanupAll();

} catch (err) {

console.error("[ONI][Pseudo][BlazingTether]", err);

fireDone({ ok: false, error: String(err && err.message || err) });

} finally {

cleanupAll();

}

`;

try {

emitLocal("oni:animationStart", { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

meta: { source: "Blazing Tether" },

});

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, "pseudo non-OK / timeout", result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "orchestration crashed", err);

} finally {

emitLocal("oni:animationEnd", { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();
